description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for three different models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), with a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 11.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU score, also with a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 33, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot displays three lines, each representing a different model: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), and Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), as well as a red line with star markers that is not explicitly labeled in the legend but appears to be associated with the models. The Consistency-CE line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 25.8 at an AL of 2.0 and increases to around 31.6 at an AL of 11.0, with a notable rise between AL values of 2.0 and 7.5. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at a BLEU score of about 26.1 at an AL of 2.0 and reaches around 31.8 at an AL of 11.0, also showing a significant increase between AL values of 2.0 and 7.5. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 26.2 at an AL of 2.5 and rises to around 32.0 at an AL of 11.0, with a similar trend. The red line with star markers starts at a BLEU score of about 29.0 at an AL of 2.5 and reaches around 32.2 at an AL of 11.0. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as AL increases.
